306:     dest: "{{ pipeline_install_dir }}/pkg/"
   307:     remote_src: true

   309:     group: lamware
   310: 
   311: - name: Ensure staged package source is traversable by the lamware group
   312:   # Both the pipeline venv (owner) and the api venv (group lamware) install
   313:   # from this tree. Symbolic +X grants execute (traverse) on directories only,
   314:   # leaving files non-executable. Idempotent on already-deployed hosts, unlike
   315:   # copy's directory_mode (which only touches newly created dirs).
   316:   ansible.builtin.file:
   317:     path: "{{ pipeline_install_dir }}/pkg"
   318:     state: directory
   319:     owner: pipeline
   320:     group: lamware
   321:     mode: "u=rwX,g=rX,o="
   322:     recurse: true
   323: 
   324: # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   325: # Pipeline virtualenv — the host-side orchestrator (run-pipeline.py), report
   326: # generator, and wrapper DB-failure handler run from this venv, so the
   327: # pipeline runtime no longer depends on --break-system-packages.
   328: #
   329: # The `pipeline` user is iptables-network-locked (cannot reach PyPI), so:
   330: #   * the venv is created as the pipeline user (offline — bundled ensurepip)
   331: #   * a wheelhouse is built as ROOT (root is not network-locked, and building
   332: #     on the host guarantees correct platform/python3.12 wheels)
   333: #   * all installs run as the pipeline user, offline, from that wheelhouse
   334: # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   335: 
   336: - name: Ensure python3-venv is installed (for the pipeline virtualenv)
   337:   ansible.builtin.apt:
   338:     name: python3-venv
   339:     state: present

   342:   ansible.builtin.command:
   343:     cmd: python3 -m venv "{{ pipeline_install_dir }}/venv"
   344:     creates: "{{ pipeline_install_dir }}/venv/bin/pip"
   345:   become: true
   346:   become_user: pipeline
   347: 
   348: - name: Create the pipeline wheelhouse directory
   349:   ansible.builtin.file:
   350:     path: "{{ pipeline_install_dir }}/wheelhouse"
   351:     state: directory
   352:     owner: pipeline
   353:     group: lamware
   354:     mode: "0750"

   359:     patterns: "*.whl"
   360:   register: pipeline_wheelhouse_existing
   361: 
   362: - name: Populate the wheelhouse as root (reaches PyPI; the pipeline user cannot)
   363:   # Building on the host guarantees wheels match the host platform + python3.12.
   364:   # Includes pip/setuptools/wheel because py3.12 venvs omit setuptools, and the
   365:   # offline source-builds of the lamware packages need a build backend.
   366:   ansible.builtin.command:
   367:     cmd: >
   368:       python3 -m pip download
   369:       --dest {{ pipeline_install_dir }}/wheelhouse
   370:       pip setuptools wheel
   371:       requests weasyprint markdown psycopg2-binary pydantic
   372:       ppdeep==20260221
   373:   register: pipeline_wheelhouse
   374:   changed_when: "'Saved' in pipeline_wheelhouse.stdout"
   375:   when: pipeline_wheelhouse_existing.matched | int == 0

   377: - name: Make the wheelhouse readable by the pipeline user

   382:   # UNCONDITIONALLY (not gated on the populate `when`) so a wheelhouse left

   385:     path: "{{ pipeline_install_dir }}/wheelhouse"
   386:     owner: pipeline
   387:     group: lamware

   389:     recurse: true
